scope_note: Evidence-supported guidance is separated from conservative inference and explicit product requirements.

principles.principle: Open with a clear role-specific purpose and a grounded connection.
principles.observable_check: Opening identifies role without compulsory boilerplate.

principles.principle: Develop a few relevant examples and explain their connection to the work.
principles.observable_check: Letter complements the resume rather than repeating all its bullets.

principles.principle: Use a concise one-page professional default unless the application specifies another format.
principles.observable_check: Explicit word/character limits override a generic default.
exceptions_or_limits: No universal exact word count is justified by these sources.

principles.principle: Company-specific claims and personal motivations require supplied reliable context.
principles.observable_check: No invented mission, culture, initiatives or emotional attachment.

principles.principle: Use a recipient name only when supplied; close professionally with a proportionate request.
principles.observable_check: No invented hiring manager or contact address.

principles.principle: Preserve the applicant’s voice and follow employer rules on AI-assisted application materials.
principles.observable_check: Draft remains reviewable; applicable AI-use restriction is retained.
